mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate persistently above 4.5% compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows < 0.03.
